Audience filters

An audience is a narrated scene that plays after a quest (or when a request unlocks it). Click one for its ink knot, characters and every gating condition it fires under — story gates, cycle scheduling, quest follow-ups, doleance/special/director schedulers, requests and filler/scene sources. Use & to OR several queries.

Dialogues

The complete in-game dialogue and script corpus: 922 knots, 91 speakers, 3,477 choices and 1,368 variables across 17 auto-classified categories — county quests, scripted quests, grievances, candidacies, endings, reactions, free-time dialogues and more. Browse the narrated scenes, the free-time dialogue of the 24 knights, quest outcomes and the ending cutscenes; filter by speaker, category, variable, function call and cross-dataset source, and jump into Quests, Knights, Special and Audiences from any knot.

Quests

All 312 quest contracts of Sovereign Tower with their stat requirements, conditions, locations, deadlines and rewards — 91 carry an unexpected outcome and 69 have modifier variants. Every quest links to the ink knot that unlocks it, the audience that follows it and the knights who prefer it, so you can trace any contract end to end.

Inventory

All 149 equipment resources of Sovereign Tower — 65 relics, 29 mounts, 44 consumables, 6 meals and 5 quest items — with their stat bonuses, character tags, exclusive and hidden flags, complex passives and the quests, shops or story knots that grant them.

Knights

The 24 playable knights of Sovereign Tower with their mastered stats, affinity and demission profiles, known and rumored features, preferred equipment, liked meals and sovereign tags, pair conversations, evolution paths and every quest and story knot they appear in.

Special

The 71 SpecialInstruction game-director switches of Sovereign Tower — knight evolution states, background and animation toggles, raise flags and more — with the firing conditions each case runs under, the ink knots that emit them and the quests that grant them.

Audiences

The 511 narrated Audience scenes of Sovereign Tower and the 34 AudienceRequest resources that unlock them, with every gating condition that makes a scene play: story and knight requirements, hardcoded cycles, quest follow-ups, doleance and special-instruction schedulers, filler packs, county introductions and ultimatum follow-ups.
